author: PC Gamer
text:
How to fish in Valheim
Where to find a fishing rod and how to catch fish in the Viking survival game.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Blizzard is aware Overwatch fans are tired of seeing its fanciest skins go to the same heroes and it's 'the number one' thing it's working to fix next
Lucio hasn't been forgotten, don't worry.

author: PC Gamer
text:
As Skyblivion's launch approaches, the team is looking for help to get the word out
But will the long-awaited mega-mod make its 2026 release target?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Wardogs CEO says he won't hire devs who aren't down with mandatory crunch: 'If you care about what you're making, this is the place to work'
A controversial stance, to say the least.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Steam reverses porn game rating it mistakenly gave to an indie vampire RPG, and despite the stress it was a 'net positive' overall as wishlists on Steam 'basically doubled overnight'
It's a happy ending, but Dave Gilbert of Wadjet Eyes Games says this was absolutely not a guerrilla marketing stunt: "I’m not that dumb and I'm not that smart!"

author: PC Gamer
text:
Wardogs delivers what Battlefield 6 was too console-brained to pull off: A real server browser
Millions of players, yet zero matchmaking.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Diablo 4 player discovers secret Diablo 2 easter egg in its new throwback season and now everyone is wondering what else Blizzard hid in there
It's more than old bosses coming back for the Season of Hell's Legacy.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I am Mark Zuckerberg
What more do I have to say?

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Witcher 3 'is not untouchable,' story director says of the upcoming expansion and remaster: 'I still find some places that I think maybe nowadays, I would do it differently'
CD Projekt is remastering its RPG masterpiece and rolling out a new expansion in 2027, and that means changes are coming.

author: PC Gamer
text:
If you need proof The Witcher 3's new expansion is in safe hands, its lead writer literally wrote her thesis on Hearts of Stone: 'To probably prove to some of my professors that games are worthy'
Mission accomplished.

author: PC Gamer
text:
No, AI, you are not human: Microsoft's code of practice for artificial intelligence actually gives me some hope for the industry
A fool's hope, perhaps.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Sega's ongoing effort to revive Crazy Taxi now appears to be taking the form of… a movie?
Yeah, I dunno either.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Witcher 3's story director says an ideal quest is 'constructed in such a way that the player puts the controller away, stands up, and starts walking'
"Then [the player] goes back, and then the player picks one of the choices."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Serial numbers on RTX Founders Edition graphics cards, including PC Gamer's very own, are fading and apparently it's causing a problem with RMA requests
If true, that could make for some expensive paperweights.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The best Total War game is getting a remaster with 50 newly playable factions, modern visuals, and a full Japanese voiceover
Even better: Shogun 2 Complete Edition arrives on October 13.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Toss a project at your printer: vibe coded tool allows developer to throw stuff at his 3D printer in VR to begin printing
Flick of the wrist.

author: PC Gamer
text:
CDPR wants to make The Witcher 3 Remastered feel like any other game released today: 'It's so easy to get used to these new improvements that it's hard to go back'
Geralt's glow up.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Blizzard finally told players where the big sword in WoW went after 8 years, and I'm just bummed out a reveal this cool was in an interview somewhere
Showing your hand.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump he agrees the AI doomsayers are perpetrating a hoax: 'you saw through all of that'
On slowing down AI, the CEO says Nvidia is "not going to let that happen."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dishonored director Harvey Smith thinks there's still room for big-budget immersive sims: 'When it really comes together and it has the budget behind it and the team, you end up with Deus Ex or Dishonored'
And now he's going to have to duke it out with Thief designer Randy Smith Evergreen.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Admitting the OGL fiasco was a 'rug pull', D&D head says 'bluntly, we're recovering from a lot of missteps—very loud, very public missteps'
"We're not going to fix it in one year."

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Steam Deck 2 has 'not really' been impacted by the memory supply crisis, with Valve still focused on a 'very delineated performance improvement' for its next handheld
Excuse me, my eyebrows rose up all by themselves.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Here's the Aniimo release time for your region
Collect creatures on the continent of Idyll.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders Expeditions may not come back: 'Maybe we'll scrap the whole system'
Right now, all options are on the table.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After nearly a year of silence following its last-minute delay, Kingmakers resurfaces with an extended gameplay video and new playtest
Still no new release date, though.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Wardogs players are actively avoiding one team in particular: 'They are literally the dumbest people on the planet'
Some are convinced one team is set up to fail.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Steam Frame launches during one of the slowest periods for VR on Steam, but Valve hopes to 'rekindle the excitement' for PCVR
"We also want to grow a healthy ecosystem for both the gamers and the game developers."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Bungie delays next Marathon update and ends 'strict seasonal schedule' as it goes all-in on Destiny-like features
Big changes are coming, but not until December.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve had next-gen VR 'headsets ready three, four years ago and they were big, bulky devices' but went back to the drawing board after actually putting them on
The versatile Steam Frame's focus is "on being lightweight and being comfortable".

author: PC Gamer
text:
Lies of P publisher files trademark for likely sequel 'Wonders of O'
Sure sounds like a sequel to me.
